_README: Practice targets for the Apheris multi-state hackathon.
HONESTY NOTE ON THE PDB IDs BELOW. Entries marked verified:true were
confirmed against the literature. Entries marked verified:false are from
recall and you MUST check them before use -- run
which downloads nothing but classifies whatever you have fetched and tells
you whether it is really in the state this file claims. That takes 30
seconds and is the difference between a real result and a wasted day.
Set sequence to AUTO to read the construct straight off the target-state
reference. Set smiles from the RCSB ligand page for the ligand code given
(rcsb.org/ligand/STI etc.) rather than trusting the string here.

abl1_imatinib.name: ABL1 kinase domain + imatinib
why: The canonical case. Type II inhibitor, binds only the DFG-out state.
Co-folding models are known to collapse onto DFG-in for ABL1, so the
baseline should fail visibly, which makes any steering effect obvious.
MSA subsampling is already known to recover both ABL1 states in AF2,
so there is a published expectation to compare co-folding levers against.

1IEP.note: c-Abl kinase domain with STI-571. Confirmed DFG-out in multiple sources.

3OXZ.note: described as a DFG-out inhibitor complex

2HIW.note: deposited as inactive-conformation Abl + type II

6XRG.note: NMR, classical DFG-out. APO -- good as a state reference, no use for pocket derivation

6XR6.note: NMR, active DFG-in. APO -- state reference only

2GQG.note: CHECK THIS ONE. Believed to be the dasatinib type I complex but not confirmed. If it fails validation, substitute any ABL1 type I holo structure that KinCore labels DFGin-BLAminus.

1FPU.note: exists; state not confirmed. Candidate DFG-in holo if 2GQG fails.

abl1_imatinib._smiles_note: imatinib, PDB chem comp STI. VERIFY at rcsb.org/ligand/STI before running the grid.

motif_overrides._why: Autodetect fails on 1IEP: the K271-E286 salt bridge is broken (alphaC-out, expected for a type II complex), so the distance search picked decoy anchors Lys274/Glu279. Values confirmed against the validated 2GQG (same ABL1 numbering).

abl1_imatinib._state_region_note: leave null and the scorer uses DFG-2..DFG+11 automatically, which is the right default. Widen it to the whole activation loop only if the margin comes out under 1 A.
abl1_imatinib._back_pocket_note: leave null; make_inputs.py derives the state-specific pocket from the two references and prints it. Paste that list here afterwards so the scorer reports back-pocket recall too.

p38a_birb796.name: p38 alpha (MAPK14) + BIRB-796
why: Second target, different kinase family, same logic -- so a result that
holds on both is a method, not a quirk of ABL1.
BIRB-796 is a textbook allosteric type II binder with a deep back-pocket
occupancy, so the state-specific contact set should be large and clean.

1KV2.note: the classic p38a DFG-out complex, confirmed in several sources

3HEC.note: p38a + imatinib. Unusual complex, so LESS likely to be memorised -- a good extra test case

2EWA.note: DO NOT use as the DFG-in reference: reported to form both DFG-in and DFG-out conformers

1A9U.note: CHECK THIS ONE. Believed to be the DFG-in SB203580 complex. Validate before use.

p38a_birb796._smiles_note: BIRB-796. Get the SMILES from the RCSB ligand page for whatever chem comp 1KV2 contains -- do not guess it.

motif_overrides._why: 1KV2 has Gly170 unmodeled, so the parsed sequence contains no contiguous DFG triplet and autodetect fails. Values confirmed against the validated 1A9U (same p38a numbering).

_stretch_targets._note: Only if the first two are done and scored. Do not start these before 3pm on Day 1.
_stretch_targets.ddr1: DDR1 is reported to have an unusually accessible DFG-out state, which makes it the interesting failure case: if steering is needed even where DFG-out is easy, that says something. 3ZOS is a candidate ponatinib complex -- UNVERIFIED.
_stretch_targets.kras_g12c: Different mechanism entirely: the switch-II pocket is cryptic and absent in the apo state. Tests whether the pocket-conditioning idea generalises past kinases. 6OIM (sotorasib) is the candidate -- UNVERIFIED, and the covalent bond adds complications you do not want under time pressure.
_stretch_targets.provided_pharma_data: If Apheris give you proprietary structures, PREFER THEM over everything above. Anything post-training-cutoff removes the memorisation confound entirely, which is the single strongest thing you can say to a judge.
